title: types.ServiceDeclaration
description: The ServiceDeclaration struct and its decoding.

title: types.Entity
description: The Entity struct.

title: types.Field
description: The Field struct, with its type and constraints.

title: types.Collection
description: The Collection struct.

title: types.SlotDeclaration
description: The SlotDeclaration struct: the collection, the slot, the operator and its fills.

title: types.ServiceDeclaration.Overrides
description: The component settings map on ServiceDeclaration, keyed by component name; a setting has no struct of its own.

title: types.ExperimentalAcceptance
description: Not written yet: STEGO has no experimental acceptance today. This names where it will live.

title: types.ServiceDeclaration.FillModules
description: Not written yet: a declaration cannot list modules for fills.

title: lifecycle.Lifecycle
description: Not written yet: this names where the digest lifecycle will live.

title: lifecycle.Supersession
description: Not written yet: this names where the supersession will live.

title: lifecycle.Withdrawal
description: Not written yet: this names where the withdrawal will live.

title: qualify
description: The result dictionary that qualify builds from run_record and writes as qualification.json.

title: run_jobs
description: The job records run_jobs reads, which require_jobs holds to the required names and a success conclusion.

title: verify_published_release
description: The asset names and digests that verify_published_release reads from the published release.

title: verification.verify
description: The record verify returns for the installed compiler: its source revision, platform and build record.

title: types.Fill
description: The Fill struct: kind, name, implements, collection, and qualified_by and qualified_at, which a person writes and nothing checks. It has no evidence and no sign-off yet.

title: types.FillEvidence
description: Not written yet: fill.yaml holds no test evidence.

title: types.FillSignOff
description: Not written yet: fill.yaml holds a name and a date in qualified_by and qualified_at, and no signature.

title: compiler.State
description: State carries the format version, and its AppliedState the record's fields. It has no service name yet.

title: compiler.ComponentState
description: ComponentState holds a component's version and SHA. computePlan in reconciler.go writes the registry reference into SHA, not a per-component digest.

title: AppliedState.Files
description: The Files map from path to hash on AppliedState; a generated file has no struct of its own.

title: compiler.InputFile
description: InputFile, held in the Files map of InputManifest, with the manifest's own digest.

title: compiler.transaction
description: The transaction and transactionOperation structs that prepareTransaction writes to .stego/transaction.yaml.

title: compiler.SavedPlan
description: Not written yet: plan returns compiler.Plan in memory, and nothing saves it.

title: registry.Registry
description: The Registry struct: the captured sources and the indexed archetypes, components and mixins. ContentHash in snapshot.go returns its content digest.

title: types.Component.OutputNamespace
description: The OutputNamespace field on Component; a namespace has no struct of its own.

title: types.Archetype
description: The Archetype struct, with its components, its conventions, its compatible mixins and its port bindings.

title: types.Archetype.Bindings
description: The Bindings map on Archetype, which binds a port to the component that provides it; a component binding has no struct of its own.

title: types.Mixin
description: The Mixin struct, with the components and slots it adds and its overrides field.

title: types.Port
description: The Port struct. It holds only the port's name today, not yet the meaning the entity states.

title: types.PortField
description: Not written yet: no port states its fields today. This names where a port field and its required meaning will live.

title: types.SlotDefinition
description: The SlotDefinition struct: the slot's name, its protobuf contract and its default.

title: types.Component
description: The Component struct: name, version, config schema, required and provided ports, slots and output namespace. It has no stage and no sunset yet.

title: types.RegistrySource
description: The RegistrySource struct in .stego/config.yaml: the location, the pinned reference, the subfolder and the vendored checkout.

title: registry.QualityEvidence
description: Not written yet: no component carries quality evidence.
